## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change that fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change that adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature causing existing behavior to change)
- [ ] Documentation only
- [ ] Refactor / chore / tests

## Checklist

- [ ] I have read [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] Linked the issue / ADR this change relates to (e.g. `Closes #123`).
- [ ] Added or updated tests that exercise the change.
- [ ] `make lint typecheck test` passes locally (backend).
- [ ] `npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test` passes locally (frontend).
- [ ] Updated `CHANGELOG.md` under `## [Unreleased]`.
- [ ] Updated relevant documentation (`README.md`, `docs/`, ADRs).
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, or production credentials in the diff.
